properties.name: A finding or refusal that fires correctly now names the route that works — fixed at the class, eight instances
properties.rationale: WHY AT THE CLASS: each 2026-09-29 root cause (live design: fact:root-cause-budget-report-reads-one-budget-and-its-refusal-never-names-the-all-budgets-sweep-2026-09-29, fact:root-cause-a-published-interface-with-outside-consumers-raises-unconsumed-interface-2026-09-29, fact:root-cause-an-external-part-trips-level-spine-disagreement-and-the-cure-is-named-only-on-its-sibling-rule-2026-09-29, fact:root-cause-parking-is-still-not-named-where-an-unsatisfied-requirement-is-read-2026-09-29, fact:root-cause-a-true-causes-edge-does-not-thread-a-cluster-and-the-finding-never-says-which-edges-do-2026-09-29, fact:root-cause-describe-schema-never-names-the-typed-tool-that-writes-a-type-and-the-map-lives-in-a-repo-script-2026-09-29, fact:root-cause-the-lens-counts-people-only-and-says-recorded-here-2026-09-29, and fact:root-cause-a-check-on-a-ruling-is-modelled-as-governed-by-and-the-verifies-refusal-never-says-so-2026-09-28) names the same class: an instruction fixed where it was reported while its siblings were never asked. The seven 2026-09-29 facts live only in the live design and are not in this branch's export, so they are named here rather than linked; the 2026-09-28 one is linked with INVALIDATES. PINNED AS THE CLASS, observed failing on a clean origin/main build (cc3dbd0) under the shared build lock: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_finding_or_refusal_names_the_route_that_works.rs (8 of 9 failed — every_edge_tool_accepts_every_pair_its_schema_models found 64 modelled pairs with no typed route: 28 CONSTRAINS, 27 CONSUMES, 5 SATISFIES, 3 DEPENDS_ON, 1 PRECEDES) and service::an_invalid_edge_names_what_the_schema_models_for_the_pair (28,237 of 28,302 refused (edge, from, to) triples named no edge the schema models for the pair). The core class pins (every_finding_that_reads_parking_names_it walks the crate source for any rule reading parking; every_rule_a_project_parent_cures_says_so walks HierarchyIssueKind::ALL) name constants the fix introduces and so do not compile on main; the behaviour they pin is observed failing through the integration tests. NOT FIXED HERE, deliberately: the unconsumed_interface detector still ignores `published` (idea D8, not promoted); a SATISFIES Component→Requirement edge (the CONTAINS union case is exempted in the class test with its measurement: 0 of 224 CONTAINS edges in reflow2's own design are Component→non-Component).
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Eight reports from the dev_reflow2 hub's two-agent exercise (art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29, I8, I9, I11, I12, I13, I14a, I14b, I17) had one shape: the check was right and its words stopped one item short of the cure. Fixed at the class: (1) every invalid-edge refusal, whichever tool raised it, names what DOES accept the pair and the typed tool that draws it (crate::writers::invalid_pair_detail, one renderer for create_edge and every helper); (2) no typed edge tool is narrower than its schema — consumes, satisfies, depends_on and constrains resolve endpoint types from the ids, and precedes takes the peer from_id/to_id spelling; (3) describe_schema answers written_by per node type and drawn_by per edge, read from crates/reflow2-mcp/writers.json, which tools/vocabulary_reach.py now reads instead of its own copy; (4) every finding that reads a parks ruling is on one list (heal::PARKING_READERS) and reaches one sentence (heal::parks_route): orphan_node in its repair note, each gap marked parks:true with the sentence once per detect_gaps reply and in the words gap_to_prompt phrases from; the detect-and-ask skill teaches it; (5) both hierarchy rules a Project parent satisfies name `contains` under the Project in one shared sentence (hierarchy::PROJECT_PARENT_CURE); (6) unthreaded_cluster names the threading edges computed from the walk's own set (nodes::traceability_edge_types); (7) the reader lens says it counts people and names the agents it leaves out; (8) budget_report's argument names closure_report's budgets leg, so its missing-argument refusal does.
